_comment: Device config. Same file for the UNO R4 test setup and the Raspberry Pi. Unknown values are the ones to calibrate (docs/04_PHOTOS_WIRING_AND_GEARTRAIN.md).

eyes._comment: address: the two HT16K33 boards must differ (A0/A1/A2 solder pads). swap: exchange which board is the screen-left eye. layout: how a virtual row (bit7 = left column) is wired to the chip: msb_left | lsb_left | adafruit (Adafruit 8x8 backpack rotates one bit). Verify with: python -m lieu_hw test eyes

ring._comment: count/chipset are fixed by the CAD; byte order is compiled into the firmware (LED_TYPE) / chosen here for the Pi. offset+reverse map the virtual LED0 (+X, counting toward +Z) onto the physical DIN order. max_scale and budget_ma protect the 5 V supply: USB test ~ 400 mA, external 5 V 2 A ~ 1800 mA.
